author_boundary: Author may synthesize upstream evidence, framework, design, risks, and fixed references. It may not create empirical results, field observations, or a new global species total.
required_messages: There is no single valid Earth species number without an estimand declaration.
Mora et al. addresses eukaryotic species; Locey and Lennon address microbial diversity with a different model and unit boundary.
Molecular units support discovery but require explicit delimitation status.
SPECIESCOPE reports non-additive estimates in parallel when integration gates fail.
